# Columns

`layout/columns` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

Side-by-side columns (1 to 4, any split) that stack on mobile, with reverse and preserve options.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | list of components (content-level) (1 to 4) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **one-column**: A single full-width column. Sets `split: 100`.
- **default**: Two equal columns. Sets `split: 50/50`.
- **three-column**: Three equal columns. Sets `split: 33.33/33.33/33.33`.
- **four-column**: Four equal columns. Sets `split: 25/25/25/25`.
- **split-60-40**: Wide left column, narrow right column. Sets `split: 60/40`.
- **split-40-60**: Narrow left column, wide right column. Sets `split: 40/60`.
- **split-70-30**: Main content with a narrow side column. Sets `split: 70/30`.
- **split-30-70**: Narrow side column with main content. Sets `split: 30/70`.
- **sidebar-left**: Small left rail and a large content area. Sets `split: 25/75`.
- **sidebar-right**: Large content area and a small right rail. Sets `split: 75/25`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileLayout` | one of `stack`, `reverse`, `preserve` | `"stack"` |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `split` | text | `"50/50"` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"top"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"0 @spacing.sm"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileLayout`: `stack`, `reverse`, `preserve`. How columns arrange on phones (stack keeps order, reverse puts the last first, preserve keeps them side by side).
- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `mobileColumns`: `1`, `2`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Columns render as a table row. Mobile-only settings (mobileColumns, mobileAlignment) are ignored. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts drops media queries and shows the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/columns', {
  "columns": [
    [
      {
        "component": "content/image",
        "data": {
          "image": {
            "src": "https://placehold.co/280x200/png?text=Linen",
            "alt": "A folded linen shirt in sand"
          }
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "Breathable linen"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h4"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Cut loose for warm days."
        }
      }
    ],
    [
      {
        "component": "content/image",
        "data": {
          "image": {
            "src": "https://placehold.co/280x200/png?text=Cotton",
            "alt": "A washed cotton tee in white"
          }
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "Washed cotton"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h4"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Soft from the first wear."
        }
      }
    ]
  ]
}) ]]
```
